description: Register an external (non-Moneda) contact with their details. EU Travel Rule requires first name, last name, and country of residence. At least one wallet address or bank account must be provided. For wallets, the user must confirm Base network USDC/EURC/CHFAU/CADD/MXNB support before saving.

countryOfResidence.description: Contact's country of residence — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. 'DE', 'US') or alpha-3 (e.g. 'DEU', 'USA') code. Required by EU Travel Rule.

email.description: Contact's email for automatic payment confirmations (optional)

firstName.description: Contact's first name (required by EU Travel Rule)

lastName.description: Contact's last name (required by EU Travel Rule)

walletConfirmed.description: Confirm wallet supports USDC/EURC/CHFAU/CADD/MXNB on Base. Required if walletAddress is provided.

name: add_contact_external
